Name: Pelican Valley Bank
Author: SourceNineLabs
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Pelican Valley Bank[/b][/size]

A lore-friendly banking system for Stardew Valley by SourceNine Labs.

Open a real deposit account, move gold between your farm wallet and the bank, earn balanced seasonal interest, and maintain a permanent financial record for your farm.[/center]


[size=4][b]A Bank That Belongs in the Valley[/b][/size]

Pelican Valley Bank is designed to feel like an institution that could genuinely operate within the Stardew Valley world.

Instead of immediately presenting another gameplay menu, the bank contacts your farm through official correspondence. Read the invitation, complete the enclosed application, and wait for the bank to approve your account.

Once approved, you receive a permanent account number and access to your bankbook.


[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Lore-friendly invitation and application process[/*]
[*]Next-morning account approval[/*]
[*]A permanent Standard Farm Account[/*]
[*]Unique account numbers[/*]
[*]Bank balance stored separately from the normal Stardew wallet[/*]
[*]Custom deposits and withdrawals[/*]
[*]100g, 1,000g, and 10,000g quick amounts[/*]
[*]Deposit All and Withdraw All options[/*]
[*]Detailed transaction history[/*]
[*]Transaction records showing the date, activity, amount, balance, and authorizing farmer[/*]
[*]Daily interest accrual[/*]
[*]Seasonal interest payments[/*]
[*]Configurable interest rate and eligible-balance cap[/*]
[*]Official seasonal account statements delivered through the mail[/*]
[*]Keyboard, mouse, and controller support[/*]
[*]Optional Generic Mod Config Menu integration[/*]
[*]Support for new and existing saves[/*]
[*]Host-authoritative multiplayer banking[/*]
[*]Support for both shared and separate multiplayer wallets[/*]
[*]Versioned and persistent save records[/*]
[*]Previous-save bank record recovery[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Opening an Account[/b][/size]

On a new farm, Pelican Valley Bank will not contact you during your first day in the valley. The invitation arrives after the bank begins processing the farm's updated property records.

Read the invitation and choose whether to submit the enclosed application or keep it for later. Submitted applications are reviewed overnight, and the approval letter arrives the following morning.

If you keep the application for later, press the bankbook key to retrieve it from your farm records.


[size=4][b]Existing Saves Are Supported[/b][/size]

You do not need to create a new farm.

Install the mod and load your existing save. Pelican Valley Bank can begin the normal invitation and application process during any season or year.

Your existing wallet, farm progress, and other save data are not replaced or converted.


[size=4][b]Using the Bankbook[/b][/size]

After your account is approved, press [b]B[/b] to open the bankbook.

The bankbook displays:

[list]
[*]Your current farm wallet[/*]
[*]Your bank account balance[/*]
[*]Pending fractional interest[/*]
[*]Account holder and account number[/*]
[*]Current interest terms[/*]
[*]Recent account activity[/*]
[/list]Depositing gold removes the same amount from your wallet and places it in the bank account. Withdrawing gold performs the opposite transfer.

Deposits and withdrawals never create additional gold.


[size=4][b]Interest[/b][/size]

Eligible balances accrue interest at each daily closing. Whole-gold interest is credited at the beginning of the next season, while fractional amounts remain pending for future payment.

The default terms are:

[list]
[*]1% interest per 28-day season[/*]
[*]Interest-bearing balance cap of 1,000,000g[/*]
[*]No fees, overdrafts, or penalties[/*]
[/list]These settings can be adjusted or disabled through Generic Mod Config Menu or the generated config file.

Interest is intended to make saving worthwhile without replacing normal farming income.


[size=4][b]Seasonal Statements[/b][/size]

At the beginning of each season, the bank prepares an official statement for the completed period.

Statements include:

[list]
[*]Account holder and account number[/*]
[*]Statement season and year[/*]
[*]Opening balance[/*]
[*]Total deposits[/*]
[*]Total withdrawals[/*]
[*]Interest credited[/*]
[*]Closing balance[/*]
[/list]Statements are retained as part of the farm's permanent bank record.


[size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]

Pelican Valley Bank supports host-authoritative network multiplayer. The host maintains the official bank record and approves every account transaction.

[b]Shared wallets[/b]

A shared-wallet farm receives one joint account. Connected players may deposit or withdraw from it after the host opens the account. The ledger identifies which farmer authorized each transaction.

[b]Separate wallets[/b]

Each player receives an individual application and personal bank account connected to their own wallet. One player cannot access another player's money or account history.

Switching between shared and separate wallets does not delete or merge existing accounts. The bank preserves the records associated with each wallet mode.

Install the same version of Pelican Valley Bank on the host and every farmhand computer.

Local split-screen multiplayer has not yet received a dedicated compatibility pass and is considered unverified in v0.1.0.


[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.

Available settings include:

[list]
[*]Bankbook key[/*]
[*]Enable or disable interest[/*]
[*]Seasonal interest rate[/*]
[*]Interest-bearing balance cap[/*]
[*]Detailed transaction retention limit through config.json[/*]
[/list]In multiplayer, the host's interest settings apply to all bank accounts.


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.0 or later[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu — optional[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download Pelican Valley Bank.[/*]
[*]Extract the Pelican Valley Bank folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Updating[/b][/size]

Replace the old Pelican Valley Bank mod folder with the new version.

Do not manually delete or edit the bank records stored with your save.


[size=4][b]Uninstalling[/b][/size]

Withdraw your bank balance before removing the mod. Gold left in the bank will not be available through the normal Stardew wallet while the mod is uninstalled.

As with any mod, back up important saves before installing, updating, or removing it.


[size=4][b]Frequently Asked Questions[/b][/size]

[b]Do I need to start a new farm?[/b]

No. Existing saves are fully supported.

[b]Is this a cheat mod?[/b]

Deposits and withdrawals only transfer existing gold. Interest is the only source of new money and is deliberately configurable and capped.

[b]Can the bank automatically pay for purchases?[/b]

Not currently. Gold must be withdrawn into the Stardew wallet before it can be spent.

[b]Does it require Generic Mod Config Menu?[/b]

No. GMCM is optional, and the mod generates a normal config file without it.

[b]Does it work in multiplayer?[/b]

Yes, for networked multiplayer. Install it for the host and every farmhand.

[b]Does it include loans, stocks, or credit?[/b]

Not in v0.1.0. This release focuses on making the core bank account polished and dependable.


[size=4][b]Future Plans[/b][/size]

Possible future banking products include savings certificates, additional account types, loans, credit products, automatic transfers, and other financial services.

Future features will continue following the same lore-friendly and balanced design philosophy.
